body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range beside an exposed floor or wall.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Independently, its space provides concealment until your next turn as debris obscures the area.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: Your Lock ignores this card's concealment. When that target leaves the obscured space, you may transfer Lock to a visible enemy still inside it.
